Strasser et al. 2010.description: Source-dimension scaling relations for subduction-zone earthquakes from Strasser, Arango and Bommer (2010), SRL. Separate regressions for interface and intraslab events. Coefficients cross-checked against the OpenQuake hazardlib implementation (openquake/hazardlib/scalerel/strasser2010.py). Intraslab length and width relations from the paper are not included here because they were not available from a verified source at transcription time; only the intraslab moment-area relation is encoded.
Strasser et al. 2010.citation: Strasser, F. O., Arango, M. C., and Bommer, J. J. (2010). Scaling of the Source Dimensions of Interface and Intraslab Subduction-zone Earthquakes with Moment Magnitude. Seismological Research Letters, 81(6), 941-950. doi:10.1785/gssrl.81.6.941
